recipe: frozen Virchow2 @ 0.2 um/px native -> dense token grid -> lightweight_conv decoder -> per-class peak heatmap -> class-aware F1@delta=3um

test_greedy._comment: OCELOT-official greedy matcher; leakage-free headline (thresholds frozen from tune). This is the leaderboard-comparable number.

test_hungarian._comment: run headline (metrics.json); agrees with greedy to +/-0.0001 here.

oracle_ceiling_diagnostic._comment: test-side threshold sweep; DIAGNOSTIC CEILING ONLY, never the reported result. The small headline->oracle gap shows the result is signal-limited, not threshold-limited.

tolerance._comment: Absolute band on mean_f1 for an independent reproduction. The dense grids are cache-identical at extraction_batch_size=8, so the only stochastic part is decoder training; cross-GPU/cuDNN nondeterminism moves mean_f1 by ~0.01-0.02. Reproductions outside this band signal a real plumbing/environment difference, not noise.
